title: What is here, in about a minute

scenes.tts: This is STEM hop. It is a free place to learn science, one short lesson at a time.
scenes.caption: This is STEMhop. It is a free place to learn science, one short lesson at a time.
scenes.narration: This is STEMhop. It is a free place to learn science, one short lesson at a time.
scenes.visual: The STEMhop wordmark with its hop arc, large and centred (shots/wordmark.png). Under it the tagline 'STEM, one short lesson at a time.' Hex stands at the right of the wordmark, still. No speech bubble.

scenes.tts: Today that means biology, from age five to graduate school, with more sciences on the way. No account needed, no ads.
scenes.caption: Today that means biology, from age 5 to graduate school, with more sciences on the way. No account needed, no ads.
scenes.narration: Today that means biology, from age 5 to graduate school, with more sciences on the way. No account needed, no ads.
scenes.visual: Real homepage, two still crops, cut at the sentence break. First the hero lede (shots/home_lede.png); an outline draws round 'from age 5 to graduate school' as it is spoken. Then the 'Pick a subject' section (shots/home_subjects.png): the Biology tile 'Open now' and the four 'Coming' tiles; outline round a 'Coming' pill at 'more sciences on the way'.

scenes.tts: A lesson is a short reading. Nearly every one has a short film, most have a simulation you can change, and practice questions explain their answers.
scenes.narration: A lesson is a short reading. Nearly every one has a short film, most have a simulation you can change, and practice questions explain their answers.
scenes.visual: Real lesson page 'Diffusion and Osmosis', three still crops in order: the top of the lesson with its hook line and film poster (shots/lesson_top.png) at 'short reading' and 'short film'; the simulation 'Two sides of a membrane' mid-use (shots/lesson_sim.png) at 'simulation'; a practice question answered correctly with its explanation showing (shots/lesson_question.png) at 'practice questions'. Outline each part as it is named.

scenes.tts: Every lesson explains its idea at more than one level. When one loses you, hop down a level, get the idea, and hop back up.
scenes.narration: Every lesson explains its idea at more than one level. When one loses you, hop down a level, get the idea, and hop back up.
scenes.visual: The site's ladder, redrawn (upright rails, one rung per level, simplest at the foot, 'Simpler' at the foot and 'Deeper' at the top) for the homepage's example idea, osmosis. Four rungs from the top: 'College, upper level: Body Fluid Compartments', 'College, a first course: Osmoregulation', 'High school: Crossing the Membrane', 'Grade 7: Diffusion and Osmosis'. Hex stands on the High school rung when the scene opens. At 'hop down a level' Hex hops down one rung to Grade 7 and its note 'Water drifts to the saltier side: weigh cucumber slices and see.' lights. At 'get the idea' Hex stays still. At 'hop back up' Hex hops back to High school. Hex moves at those two moments only. No rung is greyed, locked, filled or counted.

scenes.tts: Parents can start with thirty hands-on activities for ages five to ten.
scenes.caption: Parents can start with 30 hands-on activities for ages 5 to 10.
scenes.narration: Parents can start with 30 hands-on activities for ages 5 to 10.
scenes.visual: Real homepage, the Parents door (shots/parents.png): this week's activity card. Outline the line 'Biology Together is 30 activities for children aged 5 to 10' as 'thirty hands-on activities' is spoken.

scenes.tts: Teachers can paste in a syllabus and see matching lessons, without sending it anywhere.
scenes.narration: Teachers can paste in a syllabus and see matching lessons, without sending it anywhere.
scenes.visual: Real page /teach/match/ with the page's own sample syllabus matched (shots/match_result.png): the result headed 'Your syllabus, matched'. For the last 2 seconds the line 'Your syllabus stays on this computer...' (shots/match_private.png) with an outline round 'never sent'.

scenes.tts: AI helps make the lessons, and a person has not yet read every one, so each has a button to report a mistake.
scenes.narration: AI helps make the lessons, and a person has not yet read every one, so each has a button to report a mistake.
scenes.visual: Two still crops. The About page's 'How it is checked' list (shots/about_review.png) with an outline round the 'Human review' line ('a person has not yet checked every one by hand'). Then, at 'a button', the real 'Report an error' button in a lesson's side panel (shots/report_button.png) with an outline round the button.

scenes.tts: Start wherever you are, at stem hop dot com.
scenes.caption: Start wherever you are, at stemhop.com.
scenes.narration: Start wherever you are, at stemhop.com.
scenes.visual: The wordmark again (shots/wordmark_plain.png) with the address 'stemhop.com' under it in teal. No button, no arrow.
Standard end card. Line: 'Every lesson explains its idea at more than one level.'
